Written to `/home/bench/results/matrix.json` — valid JSON, 31 of the 32 `KnownProvider` members, keyed in union order, no extra keys.

Two judgment calls worth flagging:

- **`openai-codex` is the only omission.** It has no entry in `envMap`, no special case, and no ambient-credential block — it's OAuth-only, matching `getEnvApiKey`'s doc comment.
- **"Credential env var" ≠ "what `findEnvKeys` returns."** `findEnvKeys` deliberately excludes ambient sources, so a strict `findEnvKeys`-only reading would drop `amazon-bedrock` entirely and reduce `google-vertex` to one var. I included the ambient vars because the file itself calls them credential sources (the Bedrock comment at line 188 says "supports multiple credential sources", and the `findEnvKeys` doc at 143–145 names AWS profiles/IAM keys and Google ADC as credential sources it is skipping). I excluded `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`, `GCLOUD_PROJECT`, and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION` from `google-vertex` since those are project/region configuration rather than credentials, even though `getEnvApiKey` requires them alongside ADC. If you wanted the narrow `findEnvKeys` semantics instead, say so and I'll regenerate — that variant omits `amazon-bedrock` as well.

One nuance on precedence: for the Bedrock entry the "order" is really the short-circuit `||` evaluation order of a boolean check, not a first-match-wins key lookup, and `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`/`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` are an AND-pair rather than independent alternatives — I listed them adjacently in source order. Only `anthropic` and `github-copilot` have true first-non-empty-wins precedence.
